summary.value: Dropdown component, used to display a list of options.

a11y.method: drafted from the docs page, quote-verified, human-reviewed 2026-08-11 (batch 2: agent first-pass, ratified)

value.rule: Dropdown does not create a semantic menu itself; it provides the foundation for building one yourself
value.quote: Dropdown does not create a semantic menu, but provides the foundation for building one yourself.

value.rule: The Popover API gives built-in accessibility for open/closed state and keyboard navigation.
value.quote: There is built-in accessibility in the Popover API for open and closed state, as well as keyboard navigation.

value.rule: Enter or Space opens or closes the menu.
value.quote: Enter or Space opens or closes the menu

value.rule: Enter or Space selects the highlighted item.
value.quote: Enter or Space selects the highlighted item

value.rule: Dropdown does not include built-in keyboard handling because usage patterns vary.
value.quote: Because of the different usage patterns for Dropdown , we do not include built-in keyboard handling.

value.rule: If building a menu, you must implement your own keyboard interactions for navigation within it.
value.quote: If you are creating a menu, you must implement your own keyboard interactions to enable navigation within the menu.

value.rule: Refer to the W3C Menu and Menubar Pattern for accessible menu implementation.
value.quote: See the "Menu and Menubar Pattern" at W3C .

value.rule: Without custom logic, Dropdown.List items are Tab-navigable and the dropdown closes with Escape.
value.quote: If you use Dropdown without adding your own logic, any focusable elements inside Dropdown.List can be navigated using the Tab key, and you can close the Dropdown with the Escape key.

relations.method: drafted from the docs page, quote-verified, human-reviewed 2026-08-11 (batch 2: agent first-pass, ratified)

value.note: Use a visible Button instead of Dropdown when the action is primary or frequently used.
value.quote: Avoid dropdown when an action is primary or frequently used; use a visible button instead

composition.method: drafted from the docs page, quote-verified, human-reviewed 2026-08-11 (batch 2: agent first-pass, ratified)

value.rule: Dropdown is built internally on top of Popover.
Use Dropdown to offer multiple secondary options compactly, that should still remain easily accessible.
value.quote: Use dropdown when you want to offer multiple options without taking up much space in the interface the options are secondary but should still be easily accessible

value.rule: Use Dropdown for actions or navigation that do not need to be visible at all times.
value.quote: Use Dropdown for actions or navigation that do not need to be visible at all times

value.rule: Keep the number of items in a dropdown manageable.
value.quote: Keep the number of items manageable

value.rule: Use headings to group related items in a dropdown.
value.quote: Use headings to group related items

value.rule: Avoid nesting multiple levels of dropdowns (nested menus).
value.quote: Avoid multiple levels of dropdowns (nested menus)

value.rule: RovingFocus is offered as a utility component for keyboard navigation
value.quote: We offer RovingFocus , which is a utility component for keyboard navigation.
